name: Dead Drop vs. Active Exfil
description: Hardware implants can be configured in two fundamental modes. Dead drop mode means the device passively captures data stored locally for physical retrieval — no network traffic is generated and the device is essentially invisible to network monitoring. Active exfil mode means the device is actively transmitting captured data to an operator-controlled server, which has higher real-time capability but generates detectable network activity. Most physical engagements use dead drop mode to minimize detection risk.

blue.det: Dead drop mode — data only exfiltrated when device is physically retrieved, minimizing network detection; active mode generates C2 traffic detectable by network monitoring.
blue.cm: NAC and network monitoring to detect active C2 traffic; RF monitoring for wireless exfiltration; physical security sweeps to find dead drop devices; TSCM for high-security areas.
